name: ai_session
description: Private French AI tutor session owned by one Parle learner

user_id.description: Buildy account id of the learner who owns the session

mode.description: Tutor mode used for this session

task_id.description: Owned learner task id when this session completes a planned task, otherwise empty

skill.description: Server-resolved skill focus for this session

topic.description: Server-resolved French learning topic for this session

ended_at.description: Session end time in UTC, empty until the learner finishes

completed_at.description: Successful task-mode completion time in UTC, empty until completed

mastery_score.description: AI lesson mini-test score from 0 to 100

plan_tier.description: Server-selected tutor plan tier for this session
